notes.title: Explanation of the updated content at the beginning of next month
notes.content:
Added more languages

+Explanation of the updated content at the beginning of next month

Add Russian, Korean, Portuguese, German, French

The interactive content for the pink elf will be updated in early May~it is currently being optimized.

This update is a bit slow, I'm very sorry. Finally, I have finished my other work and can now specialize in producing game content. I believe it will be updated faster in the future. Thank you for your support~

(Translations from multiple languages may not be accurate. If you find any errors, please correct them. Thank you.)
